content: EspoCRM core (free) includes Contact/Account/Lead/Opportunity/Case entities, custom entity builder, basic list-view reports, roles/ACL, group email accounts (shared SMTP/IMAP mailboxes), REST API with API-key auth and webhooks. Paid Advanced Pack (95 one-time) adds advanced Reports (pivot/grid), Workflow automation rules, and BPM flowcharts. For v4.0 (integration logic lives in Next.js repo, not EspoCRM workflows), Advanced Pack is not required at launch.
